launches.tagline: Mapping agentic concepts onto established enterprise primitives
launches.body:
Hey YC! 

We're [Martin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/marbit/) and [Andrey](https://www.linkedin.com/in/santrosyan/) from [Redouble AI](https://redouble.ai/). We have spent our entire careers in workflow automation in highly regulated industries - and just launched **the first agentic AI operating system for enterprise in Java**. 

Our launch video:

<https://youtu.be/p2sIjfsFbHE>

# ❌ **The Problem**

Every large company’s Board wants agentic AI deployed yesterday - but **the Java engineers in the enterprise who are supposed to deliver these AI solutions can’t just abandon their stack and security model and instead adopt paradigms that go against their most fundamental engineering principles**. Put differently: no enterprise Java engineer will ship production AI in Python - the cultural and engineering mismatch is too deep. In mission-critical workflows, you can’t rely on system prompts as “guardrails”, you can’t rely on only having rudimentary permission control, you can’t rely on data being moved outside of your premises. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101524&key=user_uploads/1897636/4022bdd2-26fd-4cf9-b327-9e88da4578e0)

# **✅ The solution**

That is why we developed **Silverlake**, a Java-native AI operating system that **maps every single agentic concept and concern onto an established enterprise primitive**. Think of Bitcoin: it was a new technology, it was scary, and there was absolutely no way a bank would move its deposits into Bitcoin. But then, we got Stablecoins - mapping the new technology onto the familiar primitive of the US Dollar. And now, trillions of dollars are routinely being moved in Stablecoins, and it’s part of everyday finance. We do the same thing for agentic AI, slotting it right into the enterprise comfort zone.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101524&key=user_uploads/1897636/416be4ec-9e0c-4079-b26c-2f3895d80ce1)

**For example**, agent identity is the existing identity layer, extended. Agent audit is the existing audit framework, extended. Same for orchestration, permissions, rate limiting, observability, fault tolerance. 

With Silverlake **we empower the 12 million Java engineers worldwide to develop and deploy agentic solutions for their companies in a code-first platform**. They define an agent in a few lines of code, and Silverlake takes care of everything else, giving Java engineers the same granular control over their AI as they have over any other production system.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101524&key=user_uploads/1897636/3b4e29b9-5650-49dd-8666-3af5c376785a)

In technical terms, **Silverlake offers**:

* **Deployment** in private cloud, managed cloud, on premise, hybrid or even air-gapped environments
* Seamless **connectivity** across the entire enterprise tech stack
* True Zero Trust, **security-first architecture** with RBAC+ABAC permissions
* **Deterministic guardrails** enforced in code, impervious to prompt manipulation
* **Resource management** across operations that differ by orders of magnitude (from milliseconds to minutes)
* **Hardware and token use optimization** enabling thousands of concurrent agents even on modest hardware
* **Incorruptible domain objects** enabling deep chains of specialized and long-running agents
* **Full audit trails** with complete job lineage and structured reasoning on every AI decision
* Continuously **learning from your experts while in production**

# **💡 Examples**

Silverlake has been **developed with design partners across biopharma, insurance and financial services**. For example, our agentic workflows write submission-ready Clinical Study Reports that are hundreds of pages long, analyze entire datarooms full of financial and operational data for private equity investors, and automate claims processing for a large insurance player, from extracting data from a faxed form to comparing against the policy in place and doing full coverage determination, benefits explanation, etc. The possibilities are endless. And as it’s all plain Java, every new deployment organically generates expansion within the organization - one engineering team automates a workflow, the team next door jumps on board, and it scales by itself from there.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101524&key=user_uploads/1897636/6520cdfc-89d5-4bff-94f3-604b2df11da2)

# **❓Why Java?**

**12 million Java engineers run the world's enterprise infrastructure**. Python is the language of data science - rightfully so - but production agentic systems have far more in common with enterprise software than with a Jupyter notebook. Same transaction management, same permission enforcement, same deployment pipelines, same monitoring - and Java has been solving these problems for 30 years. There are great Java AI frameworks out there, but none that tackle the production infrastructure challenges - resource orchestration, deterministic security, observability at scale. That's what we built with Silverlake.

# **👫 The team**

**We have spent our entire careers automating complex enterprise workflows**: [Martin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/marbit/) (CEO) is a Rhodes scholar, Oxford PhD, and Wharton MBA turned serial entrepreneur who previously founded and scaled a pharma workflow automation company closing millions in enterprise deals; [Andrey](https://www.linkedin.com/in/santrosyan/) (CTO) has developed more than 120 enterprise software and AI applications in a 25 year career across large enterprise and several startups. We are backed by Y Combinator, Exponential, Transpose Platform, Tiny VC, and the Oxford Seed Fund and advised by Java inventor James Gosling and automation guru Professor Christian Terwiesch. 

We'd love your support - follow us, share us, work with us, or just say hi.

You can reach us at [founders@redouble.ai](mailto:founders@redouble.ai) and <https://redouble.ai>

[Book a Demo](https://calendly.com/d/cqhn-9ft-kzq/redouble-ai-demo)

launches.title: Opslane – Making on-call suck less
launches.tagline: We reduce alert fatigue for on-call teams.
launches.body:
**TL;DR**

Our [Slack bot](https://github.com/opslane/opslane) classifies your Datadog alerts and flags noisy alerts, reducing alert fatigue.

Additionally, we generate insights based on all your alerts to give you a picture of your overall alert hygiene.

### The Problem

**Picture this:** It's 3AM, and you're woken up by a page. It's an error you've seen before, and you know it wasn't worth waking up for.

Anyone who's been on-call knows the infamous middle-of-the-night unactionable alert all too well.

Even with modern tools, it's still tough to determine when something has actually gone wrong, the user impact, and how to fix it quickly.

**Why are existing solutions not cutting it?**

* Lack of context - it's really hard to understand the customer and business impact from looking at an alert.
* Alerts are noisy and not actionable.
* Debugging requires context switching between multiple siloed tools.

### Our solution

We're starting with our open source Slack bot that reduces alert noise.

Once you add our bot to your Slack channel, we pull your alert history from Datadog.

We analyze your alert history across various parameters:

* Alert frequency
* How quickly have the alerts resolved in the past
* Alert priority
* Alert response history

Based on these, we classify your alert as actionable or noisy.

![User-uploaded](https://slabstatic.com/prod/uploads/s97i19pj/posts/images/6P01k6pFnPq5repaabLC5_-G.png)

In addition, we generate a report on your team's overall alert health, pinpointing which noisy alerts are prime candidates for tuning or disabling.

![User-uploaded](https://slabstatic.com/prod/uploads/s97i19pj/posts/images/1e4X0_iAo7eLJh7PLEo1oZoS.png)

Our vision is to stitch together all the relevant context engineers need to debug incidents in one place and automate root cause analysis.

### Team

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82453&key=user_uploads/6530/ba62e789-6ccf-4b5c-a555-90e5c932d81c)

We ([Amaresh](https://linkedin.com/in/amareshray/) and [Abhishek](https://linkedin.com/in/abhishek-ray-29210145)) have firsthand experience dealing with the challenges of on-call and alert fatigue at companies like Robinhood and Atlassian. With Opslane, we’re reducing the alert fatigue that overwhelms on-call engineers and leads to millions in lost productivity and downtime.

### Ask

🔥 Are noisy alerts a hair-on-fire problem for your company or someone you know? We'd love to hear from you - email [founders@opslane.com](mailto:founders@opslane.com) or [schedule a call](https://cal.com/team/opslane/demo) with us.

# ❌ The Problem:

Compliance and trust are major barriers to scaling AI, with [one in two executives fearing reputational damage.](https://www.complianceweek.com/surveys-and-benchmarking/deloitte-survey-ai-adoption-raising-concerns-about-trust-reputational-damage-ethics/35411.article)

**The cost of non-compliance is rising:** Fines of [7% annual revenues (or 35M EUR)](https://artificialintelligenceact.eu/article/99/#:~:text=Non%2Dcompliance%20with%20the%20prohibition,financial%20year%2C%20whichever%20is%20higher.) for non-compliance with EU AI Act; [similar regulations are fast approaching in the US.](https://www.cnet.com/tech/services-and-software/biden-administration-wants-ai-guardrails-heres-its-call-to-action/)

**Companies are not ready:** Only 6% feel ready to accommodate these changes, while [80% are committing](https://www.accenture.com/us-en/insights/artificial-intelligence/ai-compliance-competitive-advantage) 10%+ of their AI budgets to compliance.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85206&key=user_uploads/2208234/45bf4fb3-686e-4532-baf9-c53860dcc7dd)

# ✅ Use cases:

Most customer- or employee-facing AI applications require guardrails:

* **Search:** Block non-compliant queries and prevent exposing sensitive or proprietary information to users.
* **Chatbots:** Ensure responses are accurate and compliant with company policies.
* **Assistants:** Stop misleading advice in violation with company policies that could cause negative PR or legal risks.
* **Agents**: Control scope and prevent unauthorized actions or transactions.
* **Recommendation engines**: Filter outputs to avoid biased, irrelevant or offensive suggestions that damage brand trust.
* **Decisioning systems**: Ensure automated decisions (e.g., loan approvals, hiring) meet regulatory standards and prevent discriminatory outcomes.

No enterprise-grade guardrail solutions exist today. Companies **incur $1-10M+ in costs annually** **and 6-12 months in delays** building guardrails in-house.

2. **Evaluate** your guardrails using Galini’s synthetic test generator and evaluation engine

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85206&key=user_uploads/2208234/d28cc55e-38e2-404b-a4bb-5bd58c55eba8)

4. **Monitor** and improve performance by providing feedback to Galini’s agent

name: CTGT
long_description:
CTGT is an applied AI research laboratory fundamentally solving the alignment and reliability bottleneck for enterprise AI.

For enterprises, especially highly regulated industries, deploying Generative AI is historically a compromise between capability and catastrophic risk. Standard enterprise approaches, such as RAG, fine-tuning, and prompt engineering, operate at the wrong abstraction layer. They are inherently probabilistic, carry massive engineering overhead, and fail to deliver the mathematical certainty required by the Fortune 500.

We focus on the science of representation engineering and have productized mechanistic interpretability. By opening the "black box" of neural networks, CTGT has developed a proprietary architecture that intervenes directly at the model's representation layer. We convert complex corporate SOPs, SEC/FINRA regulations, and strict editorial rulebooks into machine-readable "Policy as Code," enforcing deterministic constraints and defensible audit trails without requiring expensive model retraining.

The result is a step-function breakthrough in enterprise AI economics and capability. Our fundamental architecture allows organizations to run secure, self-hosted open-source models that mathematically match the reasoning and performance of frontier models. Benchmarks from our enterprise deployments demonstrate a 96.5% prevention of hallucinations, up to a 3.3× accuracy multiplier in complex domain-specific tasks, and an 80-90% reduction in human-in-the-loop manual review.

Backed by an $8M seed round from Gradient Ventures (Google), General Catalyst, and Y Combinator, CTGT is currently deployed with Fortune 500 companies, including Tier-1 financial institutions and global media conglomerates, giving them the deterministic control necessary to deploy enterprise AI with zero margin for error.

launches.body:
We're building the future of trustworthy AI deployment. CTGT helps enterprises eliminate hallucinations and unwanted behavior in LLMs while dramatically accelerating time-to-production.

[Utilizing CTGT's Platform for Model Evaluation and Monitoring 🚀 - Watch Video](https://www.loom.com/share/7e4948fa0ccf4256b2f7036ee8d7baf4)

## **The Problem: “Black Box” of AI**

The status quo of deep learning involves throwing more compute at models with the expectation that they will achieve true intelligence. The questionable nature of this assumption aside, this will certainly lead to more complex models that we don’t meaningfully understand.

I’ve been obsessed with AI and its potential to change the world since I was a kid. In high school, I took apart old laptops to eke out just a bit more performance to train models, so I’m exceedingly aware how important access to and understanding AI is. (For more background, check out the great piece [TechCrunch did on us](https://techcrunch.com/2024/10/29/ctgt-aims-to-make-ai-models-safer/).)

Enterprise companies are sitting on powerful AI models but can't deploy them due to hallucinations and unpredictable behavior.

* Healthcare providers can't risk medical chatbots giving dangerous advice
* Financial firms need guarantees their AI won't recommend fraudulent investments
* Tech companies need AI that consistently aligns with their brand voice

## **Our Solution: Principled AI Development**

CTGT takes a fundamentally different approach. Rather than black-box approximations, we've developed breakthrough technology that understands [how neural networks actually learn](https://openreview.net/forum?id=8WiNDyXgj6). 

This allows us to:

* Automatically detect and eliminate hallucinations
* Train models 10x faster with 10x less compute
* Give enterprises foundational control over AI behavior

How it works:

Let’s imagine we ask an LLM about cooking food. 

_I started lunch by simmering water on the stove. I prepared dough for a homemade pizza dish. Using a knife, I sliced fresh tomatoes and cheese. I spread glue on the bread for tomorrow's breakfast. The dough rose in the oven. I brewed tea while stirring the soup with a spoon. A plate was set, and lunch was nearly complete. Every pot and utensil had its place._ 

We can determine, for example, that pizza and bread is part of the “food” concept in the model, along with other related things in the output.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WSDro9tEz_w> 

And we can determine that “glue” shouldn’t be part of this concept.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=skW5Z5CPr9o> 

Our technology ensures “glue” doesn’t appear in queries regarding food, reducing hallucinations by 80-90%.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sH8x9boOtF4> 

## **Real Results with Fortune 10 Companies**

We're already helping major enterprises deploy AI with confidence:

* Removed bias from facial recognition systems in one step
* Eliminated investment advice hallucinations for portfolio managers
* Enabled fraud detection LLMs with precise error identification

## **The Team**

Founded by UCSD researchers pushing the boundaries of AI:

* Cyril Gorlla (CEO): Recipient of the Endowed Chair's Fellowship at UCSD. His work on efficient AI training was invited for presentation at ICLR and his talk at Ai4 was the most attended in its track. He collaborated with Intel on ML telemetry deployed on 8M+ CPUs. He was named one of 12 “2022 Shining Stars” at UCSD and is an Ivory Bridges Fellow and Nordson Leadership Scholar. He was advised by ACM and Amazon Fellow Mikhail Belkin.
* Trevor (CTO): Deep learning researcher focused on high powered distributed ML systems under Hao Zhang, a student of Databricks Founder Ion Stoica, at UCSD.

## **Why Now**

Legacy companies and those without access to massive amounts of compute can greatly benefit from specialized, domain-specific AI. Current LLM interpretability methods are extremely inefficient, effectively rendering them inaccessible to the vast majority of companies. There’s a shift from large foundation models to those tailored to each company’s brand and applications. Our technology enables this future by making state-of-the-art AI accessible without massive compute resources.

## **Interested in the Next Generation of AI?**

Book a meeting at [ctgt.ai](http://ctgt.ai) if you're:

* A regulated enterprise (healthcare/finance etc.) looking to safely deploy AI
* Struggling with LLM hallucinations or slow iteration cycles
* Want to reduce AI compute costs by 10x while improving reliability

## **Looking For**

* Introductions to enterprises bottlenecked by AI trust/reliability issues
* Feedback from companies dealing with hallucination challenges

launches.title: AutoComputer - Zero setup AI automation for your computer
launches.tagline: AI automation for your computer that predicts the next steps in your workflow, completing them with a single keystroke
launches.body:
AutoComputer helps you automate and accelerate workflows on your computer without any explicit configuration, while keeping you in-charge.

With just a prompt and your recent activity, our desktop AI system starts predicting the next sequence of actions – keystrokes, text input, mouse clicks – that you can keep accepting with a single keystroke. This saves you time and effort while providing you complete visibility and control over the completed tasks.

We’re starting with helping businesses and enterprises automate repetitive, but business-critical workflows such as financial data entry, record keeping, and transaction matching.

Watch our demo video below to see AutoComputer in action!

<https://youtu.be/tcFpwrvB7FE>

---

\
 

## The Context

As engineers, we have tools like Github Copilot, Cursor and software engineering agents that help us accelerate and automate large swaths of our programming workflows with AI.

However, outside programming, this is not the case. Many professionals in roles such as accounting, consulting and bizops have repetitive, critical workflows that they want to accelerate or automate with software, but they don’t yet have an ideal solution for this.

---

\
 

## The Problem

Based on talking to these users, we learnt that the current generation of RPA and AI Agent-driven automation solutions for their workflows have 3 core issues:

**Trust and Accountability**

For many tasks they need to ensure accuracy and take accountability. So RPA and Agents that just go off do the task for them are not a viable option. They **need full visibility and control** while the automation executes.

**Configuration Complexity**

Real-world workflows are complex and span multiple apps and files. Many solutions can’t handle them without the **heavy setup, onboarding, or migration required** with the current generation of RPA tools or AI agent-driven automation solutions.

**Automation Flexibility**

Workflows change frequently across formats and tools and they want automations that can adapt on the fly without reconfiguration. Most **automations fail on the slightest variation** in data formats, schemas or sources introduced when they had new clients, cases and customers.

---

\
 

## The Solution

With just a prompt, our desktop AI system automates steps for any complex computer usage workflow that they can accept with a single keystroke. It makes repetitive but critical workflows such as financial data entry 2-5x faster, while providing complete visibility, control, and adaptability—all without requiring any setup, recording, or onboarding to a new platform.

Here’s a how it works:

1. The user opens the AutoComputer app on Windows/MacOS and provides a prompt for their task.
2. AutoComputer understands the context of the task and comes up with a sequence of automated steps of mouse and keyboard input to complete the task.
3. The user can simply evaluate and proceed through accepting the automated steps with a single key press, or correct or reject at the granular level without having to fix or re-run the whole workflow.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdA-_EassCAkh3NIgYNUy0QtBbuSm3b7rDw_Wdv-gvjYtwkxNH8_TJV7Cwi3084NeHRmOA2ouoeQCVdtvbBRH1JwGpxj0zSDiSWS0MfGTMbXQWV_o0pD_ZyNPEksny-Vysd8TglgW7oVXIukQ71ePbewo7R?key=-egX7nlYaXVPDP4d-BBxFX_D)

---

\
 

## The Team

We are [Madhav](https://x.com/madhavsinghal_) and [Rick](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rick-sugden-4a427b180/).

We met at university \~7 years ago while doing research in Physics. We have been friends and roommates and have hacked on multiple research and side projects together.

Rick recently dropped out of his PhD where he worked on training transformers on brain-wave data for diagnosis, and built the first at-home brain-tumour monitoring system which he patented.

Madhav worked at Replit as one of the first engineers on the AI team where he led research and training for all of Replit’s models, and worked on data infrastructure, Replit’s core AI services and, most recently, Replit Agent.

Based on our experience in AI research and building products like the Replit Agent, we believe that SOTA models are just crossing the threshold of capability where they can start usefully automating and accelerating large parts of knowledge work beyond just software engineering. We are building AutoComputer to realize this for ourselves and for our users.

---

 \
 

## Our Ask

If you are an enterprise or a business with teams doing repetitive back office workflows like data entry, who can benefit from AutoComputer, reach out to us at: [founders@autocomputer.ai](mailto:founders@autocomputer.ai)

If you are an individual or employee who wants to use AutoComputer to accelerate your workflows, you can sign up for our waitlist on <https://www.autocomputer.ai/>.

launches.title: superglue 🍯 - Open Source Data Translation
launches.tagline: Get data from any system in exactly the format you need.
launches.body:
**Tl;dr** [superglue](https://superglue.cloud/) translates data from any system into exactly the format you need. It’s an open source proxy that automatically extracts, maps and transforms data so developers don’t have to write and maintain complex integration code. 

**Other tools say "Use our API". superglue says "Use any API, in any way you want".**

[Find us on GitHub.](https://github.com/superglue-ai/superglue)

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXejwKUtg5vNmIUFVD-naIZc3NVJVO4nIxzG1bVC5SkaA8g5JuhP7I9QWTBXPVCbKQdc6OY7bgFgVuJPf99JjYyBK3Y2TDpGG_ehUirAvBmANq8dkq9EpyY-72Dn56s6dW3LA6n82g?key=X6C0DCn4htyY5GQ3HDPmoqgF)

# **Why it matters**

Most companies struggle with data integration challenges daily. Energy providers pull meter readings from thousands of devices, fashion marketplaces standardize product data from various retailers, and fintech companies normalize transaction data across payment systems. Each system speaks its own language, forcing developers to write and maintain custom code to transform and normalize data. It's a massive waste of engineering resources and slows down business innovation.

# **What we’re building**

_superglue_ is an intelligent proxy server that automatically transforms data from external APIs into your desired format, eliminating the need for custom mapping code. By sitting between your application and APIs, it allows developers to define data structures once and apply consistent transformations across all integrations, turning complex data integration from a weeks-long project into a minutes-long configuration. The superglue proxy can sit outside your codebase - particularly good for legacy systems that are brittle and hard to change.

**Key features**

* **One-off LLM-powered translations**: Generate deterministic, high-performance translation code.
* **Self-healing**: Detect format changes and update translations automatically
* **Fast deployment**: Supports most APIs and data formats out of the box
* **For enterprise**: Hosting, logging, retries, caches, access control

## **Get Started**

1. [Get access](https://superglue.cloud/) to our hosted version or install superglue as a lightweight local proxy
2. Pick an API / data source to connect to
3. Define your desired data output format

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87434&key=user_uploads/1344607/34c24883-0af1-4dd0-89a7-4493b1913ddb)

4. Let superglue handle transformations and schema enforcement

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfITHd_G-ZeA03HGoDOL8Oql_Jb4Pu50FWrLhRVldLEMgSyUN-cMsaY6T-Vx3xqEpyLz-6zWnejpU_1siA-1-LLX7okg-r2YqTaeDcU3xuAkAbgvGfWmVi4i-yyCVOuKaeQWGajlA?key=X6C0DCn4htyY5GQ3HDPmoqgF)

<https://youtu.be/Bzbw3Oh9zIg>

**How is this different from connector platforms and unified APIs?**

Unlike platforms that offer predefined APIs for specific verticals and require developers to adapt to their specifications, _superglue_ provides universal data transformation that works with any API or data source. We give developers complete flexibility to transform data however they want, without vendor lock-in. Where other platforms support a limited set of integrations, _superglue_ can transform data from literally any source - whether it's a well-known API or a custom internal system - putting developers in full control of their data pipelines.

**What if I want to own the integrations I build?**

You totally can with _superglue_. As an open-source solution, we provide full transparency and the ability to modify transformation logic at any level, ensuring you're never trapped in a black box. Unlike closed integration platforms, you own 100% of the integration logic. You can host the entire solution on your own infrastructure, with full access to source code and transformation rules.

# **Get superglued**

Are you currently building integrations, onboarding customers via integrations or too strapped to integrate them? Email us at [founders@superglue.cloud](https://mailto:founders@superglue.cloud), we’re happy to help.

Have you built data-heavy integrations in the past? We want to speak to you!

Otherwise get started on [Github](https://github.com/superglue-ai/superglue) or [book a demo](https://cal.com/teamindex/superglue-demo).

# **About us**

[Stefan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/stefan-faistenauer/) and [Adina](https://www.linkedin.com/in/adinagoerres/) first met in 2019 while studying in Munich. Their shared experience in the integration space led them to superglue.

launches.body:
[Watch our AI Agents in action:](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pWOc8s5bjyY)

**TL;DR:** Agentin AI builds AI Agents that automate the entire Quote-to-Cash (QTC) workflow by connecting with enterprise systems like Salesforce, NetSuite, and SAP. We eliminate incomplete orders, mismatched data and delayed payments, cutting down QTC from weeks to minutes and boosting cash flow. [Here's a quick podcast overview.](https://open.spotify.com/episode/2hKTVSOJS7aFpSJR16v1dt)

**What is Quote-to-Cash (QTC)?** Quote to Cash is the full business process from receiving customer orders through fulfillment, invoicing, payment collection, and reconciliation.

**Why this matters:** Slow or inefficient QTC processes directly delay cash flow, add operational overhead, and limit business growth.

**The Problem:** Companies dealing with high order volumes typically struggle with:

* **Incomplete Orders:** Missing details cause delays.
* **Mismatched Data:** Manual errors create reconciliation headaches.
* **Delayed Payments:** Inefficient processes slow down cash collections.

These issues often extend QTC from days to weeks, impacting revenue and productivity.

**Our Solution:** Agentin AI’s Agents connect with existing enterprise CRM and ERP systems to:

* **Automate Data Entry:** Remove manual input, reducing errors.
* **Ensure Data Consistency:** Detect and fix data mismatches automatically.
* **Accelerate Payments:** Speed up invoicing and reconciliation, cutting QTC time from weeks to minutes.

**Backstory:** I am Sankeerth Rao Karingula, founder of Agentin AI (YC W25) and an ex-Google Research Scientist. At Agentin AI, we develop reinforcement learning algorithms so our AI Agents can learn and adapt from failures. After seeing how manual QTC processes slow businesses down, I built Agentin AI to solve these inefficiencies.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88196&key=user_uploads/423828/a3e2119a-1948-4ce1-8abc-09ce48991a91)

**Our Ask:**

* Could you introduce us to finance or ops leaders at companies with $100M+ in revenue and handling 1,000+ orders per month?
* If your organization faces manual QTC challenges, schedule a demo at [agentin.ai](https://www.agentin.ai/) or contact me at [sankeerthrao@agentin.ai](mailto:sankeerthrao@agentin.ai).

Thank you! We’re dedicated to automating away manual Quote-to-Cash inefficiencies so teams can focus on higher-value tasks.

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
We all combine deep domain expertise in mid-market and enterprise workflow automation. 

Lorenz and Jonas worked together for 4+ years at TradeLink (SCM-SaaS backed by Point Nine, Insight), accompanying the path from 0 to product-market fit. Lorenz led Product; Jonas led Go-to-Market. Both quit their leadership roles to found Finto. 

Knowing each other from the Munich startup scene, Linus joined as Co-Founder & CTO. He was previously an early tech lead at Tacto (Procurement SaaS backed by Sequoia, Index), helping scale it from pre-seed to one of Europe’s largest Series A rounds in mid-market SaaS.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
Enterprises with complex vendor supply chains produce vast amounts of incoming vendor invoices each year. A typical **mid-market enterprise processes \~100k incoming invoices** **yearly**, and today, an accountant tops out at \~10-20k invoices per year because the real grind is still manual: 

* Key-stroking invoice data to the ERP
* Manual invoice review and compliance checks
* Manual managing deviations with purchase orders
* Manual allocate ledger accounts and cost center codes
* Chasing approvals. That’s why enterprises still staff large accounting teams - or ship the work to shared-service centers.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
AI will write the final chapter of accounting software. What once required teams, training, and manual effort now happens in real-time - intelligently, autonomously, and at scale through agents. 

Finto is our contribution to this future. As AI agents become capable of understanding context, learning from company-specific data, and executing complex workflows, entire job profiles will shift away from manual execution. With its predictable but intricate schemes, accounting is poised to be one of the first areas transformed. 

Doubling down on our domain expertise, we are on a mission to **take the manual out of accounting**.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=otqOvfepgKQ

**TL;DR**

Finto builds an AI accounting software for enterprise finance teams. We automate the invoice-to-pay process from their email inbox to their ERP including invoice handling, supplier communication, 3-way matching, and ERP data entry.

**Problem**

Enterprises with complex vendor supply chains produce vast amounts of incoming vendor invoices each year. A typical **mid-market enterprise processes \~100k incoming invoices** **yearly**, and today’s legacy tools force accountants to top out at a fraction of the volume: Real manual grunt work still remains:

* Handling hundreds of mails and documents a day
* Key-stroking invoice data to the ERP
* Manual invoices checks and account coding
* Manual managing deviations with purchase orders
* Chasing approvals

That’s why enterprises still staff large accounting teams - or ship the work to shared-service centers. Our mission is to free the world’s finance teams from repetitive, low-value tasks so they can focus on impactful work. That starts with building a place where everyone can do their best work.

**Solution**

We build a platform embedding AI agents to automate the end-to-end invoice-to-pay cycle:

1. **Classify** inbox documents (invoice, receipts, reminder)
2. **Read** invoices at **99%+ accuracy** - even on line item level
3. **Check** on vendor, tax, bank, and compliance data
4. **Email vendors** automatically if something’s off
5. **Understand & code** ledger, cost-center or project numbers
6. **Three-Way-Match** invoice orders with POs and GRs
7. **Collect** **&** **chase** required approvals
8. **Post to ERP**

**Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92119&key=user_uploads/517834/3c1f90e4-a068-4456-9e57-cdc10fe024d3)

We combine deep domain expertise in enterprise workflow automation. 

[Lorenz](https://www.linkedin.com/in/lorenz-neuner/) and [Jonas](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jonasmorgner/) worked together for 4+ years at TradeLink (European Logistics-SaaS backed by Point Nine, Insight Partners), accompanying the path from 0 to product-market fit. Lorenz led Product; Jonas led Go-to-Market. Both quit their leadership roles to found Finto. 

Knowing each other from the Munich startup scene, [Linus](https://www.linkedin.com/in/linus-boehm/) joined as Co-Founder & CTO. He was previously an early tech lead at Tacto (Procurement-SaaS backed by Sequoia, Index), helping scale it from pre-seed to one of Europe’s largest Series A rounds in mid-market SaaS.

**CTA**

You’re interested in our product? [Book your demo here](https://www.finto.de/request-demo).

If you know a CFO or accounting leader, we are eager to help them make their process more efficient - please reach out: [jonasm@finto.de](mailto:jonasm@finto.de)

Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/fintoai/) or visit our [website](https://www.finto.de/).

launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋

We’re [Evan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/evanameyer/) and [Jeet](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jeetchugh/) – co-founders of [Mod AI](https://usemod.ai).

# **TL;DR**

**Mod AI automates the manual work of processing invoices for growing enterprises.** We’ve already helped accounting teams of 1-20+ streamline their invoice processing by 83%.

**_Ask:_** Can you introduce us to CFOs, controllers, Accounting Directors, or Accounts Payable managers of mid to large companies that could benefit from streamlining their accounting processes with AI? Contact us at [evan@mod-ai.org](mailto:evan@mod-ai.org)

https://youtu.be/XaT6mEQnWmE

# ❌ The Problem

Most growing enterprises still process invoices manually—hiring AP clerks to comb through inboxes, type up documents, and chase approvals. As volume grows, they scramble to add more headcount or outsource to expensive temps.

This creates three major pains:

1. **Cash flow blindness** – No visibility until month-end close
2. **Unscalable manual work** – More invoices means more clerks (highest-turnover role in finance)
3. **Vendor relationship damage** – Late payments and errors erode trust

We talked to 23 CFOs last month—nearly all said their AP process couldn't scale.

# 👷 Our Solution

Mod AI deploys AI agents that handle your accounts payable process end-to-end—from the moment an invoice arrives to the moment it's paid and synced to your books. Companies simply connect their systems and instantly get:

* **Complete invoice capture** 📥**:** Auto-pull from email, supplier portals, EDI, physical mail
* **Intelligent processing** 🧠**:** 97%+ accurate GL coding, 2-way/3-way matching, fraud detection
* **Seamless approval & payment** ✅**:** Custom workflows, one-click approvals, direct sync to accounting software

**Result:** Real-time spend visibility, 10x invoice volume without hiring, and stronger vendor relationships.

# 🙏 Our Ask

If you answer "yes" to any of these, we'd love your help:

* **Do you know any mid-market CFOs, Controllers, or VP Finance leaders** whose AP teams are drowning in manual invoice work? Or are you one yourself? We'd love to show you a demo and discuss how Mod AI can help you scale without adding headcount.
* **Can you introduce us to any finance operations networks or communities** where leaders are looking for AI solutions to automate back-office work?
* **Can you introduce us to any accounting firms, fractional CFO groups, or ERP consultants** who work with mid-market companies in financial services, insurance, or manufacturing?

👉 **Contact us at [evan@mod-ai.org](mailto:evan@mod-ai.org)**

\
**TL;DR:** Rapidfolio automates the most complex manual compliance, operations, and fraud processes that analysts perform at fintechs and banks today. We do this with 100% accuracy, speed, and auditability. We are previous founders and operators in fintech, and created Rapidfolio because we wished it existed when we were running Sable (S19).\
\
**Video:**\
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UBIfRhNh08>

\
**Our Ask:**\
**If you are a founder or operator at a fintech** **or bank** **who**\
i) has a pressing need to automate manual tasks due to high volume and/or,\
ii) needs to decrease the amount you spend annually on back-office staff or\

Reach out directly: [founders@rapidfolio.com](mailto:founders@rapidfolio.com) or book a demo: <https://cal.com/naveen-qureshi/demo>

**The Problem** 

Fintechs and banks spend up to **30% of their revenue** on operations, compliance, risk and fraud back-office staff. The back-office performs manual processes like KYC and KYB reviews, OFAC/sanctions/watchlist reviews, fraud investigations, disputes and chargebacks, mortgage and loan underwriting, and sometimes even manual data input workflows, among others. The back-office scales as a function of the number of accounts held at the fintech/bank and quickly becomes extremely costly, time consuming, and error prone. 

Frederik and I lived this problem firsthand. **We started Rapidfolio because we wished it existed when we were running Sable (S19)!**

**Our Solution** 

Rapidfolio turns manual compliance, operations, risk and fraud processes into accurate, auditable, and automated flows. We’re running at **100% accuracy** in production. We provide the **end to end platform and services** to:

**1. Convert your existing procedure** into deterministic, automated, workflows in minutes.

**4. You have full visibility and control:** all workflows are version controlled, and each action is auditable and traceable. You can include humans-in-the-loop where needed. All analytics live directly in your dashboard.

Rapidfolio provides “innate abilities” like automated web browsing, document reading/analysis, comprehensive summaries, human-level judgment, to name a few. Additionally, Rapidfolio integrates easily into your **existing tech stack**. We have built-in integrations with leadings operations, compliance and fraud vendors in the financial services industry.

We are SOC 2 compliant, and are **live with customers across the U.S. and Canada.**

Previously was co-founder & CEO of Sable (S19) that I built, scaled and sold. After Sable’s exit, I built and launched additional credit products with [Seen.com](http://Seen.com). Ex Capital One, Amazon, Target. Columbia Business School.\

Previously built the entire banking stack for two fintechs from scratch. First, as founding engineer at Sable (S19), where he shipped the entire banking stack in a record 3 months, pre-AI. And after Sable’s exit, with Seen.com. Fred also built internal tools for back-office staff at both fintechs, and is passionate about automating the more tedious workflows with Rapidfolio.\

We work with data-center and AI-infrastructure power, motor drives, industrial automation and robotics, industrial power supplies and conversion, battery systems and e-mobility powertrains, EV charging, solar, energy storage, grid power, HVAC, heat pumps, and appliances.

V1 boards built from off-the-shelf parts are great for getting to market quickly, but scaling to v2+ volume requires optimizing cost, size, and manufacturability. Visibl folds those parts into custom silicon built around the product: a simpler BOM, reclaimed board space, fewer supply constraints, and automation-ready assembly.

We manage the full path from architecture and design through verification, fabrication, packaging, and production-ready silicon, working alongside hardware teams so they do not need an in-house chip team.

launches.tagline: Meet Visibl, The First AI-enabled Coordination Layer for Chip Design
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋\
We’re Bryce and Jordon, co-founders of VISIBL SEMICONDUCTORS™\
\
**Launch video:** <https://youtu.be/l_0BcKIIU3Q>

---

**TL;DR**\
_Visibl is the first coordination layer for chip design._ Requirements, architectural intent, and implementation drift out of sync as designs and teams scale. Visibl surfaces drift early, opens cases with evidence, and delivers review-ready fixes enabling improved schedule, cost, and risk outcomes in chip design.

Check out LinkedIn post here:\
<https://www.linkedin.com/posts/y-combinator_visibl-semiconductors-yc-w26-is-building-activity-7430280268252590081-UBoI/>

**Problem**\
Coordination has always been a human job: monitoring drift, triaging failures, keeping the schedule aligned. It demands constant vigilance, reacting to failures, proactively scanning for issues, always watching.

As designs scale, no one can hold all that context: the specs, the implementation, the test results, the decisions scattered across Slack, Jira, and docs. Issues slip through. Drift compounds. We saw this firsthand. There was no software to solve it. So we're building it.

Our experience spans chip design and high-stakes production systems. We're solving a problem there was never enough human bandwidth to address, but one that directly impacts the most important outcomes in chip design: schedule, cost, and risk.

**What Visibl Does**\
\
**Monitors** - specs, implementation, CI, and all design collateral to detect drift early

**Investigates** - creates cases with evidence: spec sections, RTL refs, CI logs, historical decisions

**Proposes** - agents suggest fixes, run verification, package review-ready diffs

**Gates** - human approval required, nothing ships without explicit sign-off

### —

\
**Results**\
\
**Schedule** - Eliminate weeks lost waiting for the one engineer with context to debug failures

**Cost** - 10x less engineering overhead on triage; your team builds instead of firefighting

**Risk** - Catch issues early to minimize rework; avoid late-stage surprises that lead to $10M+ respins\
\
\
\
\
**Instant Dispatch & Case Creation**

launches.tagline: Deploy enterprise software in days, not months
launches.body:
Enterprise software takes months to go live after the sale. Imagine paying for an app on the app store but not being able to use it for 6 months. [Lab0](https://lab0.ai/) solves exactly this.

We’re building an AI FDE that automates entire post-sales delivery for software companies - all from discovery, solution design, config, to testing and go-live. We’re currently working with Adobe and a couple of system integrators.

The future of enterprise software is self-serve, where enterprises buy a product, and it gets configured by agents.

[Lab0](https://www.linkedin.com/company/lab0-hq/) is the AI FDE making that real: 6 months → 10 days.

<https://youtu.be/UDrqfnYWlLI>

# **The problem**

If you've sold to an enterprise, you know this already.

A $200K contract lands. Hand off to post-sales. On a deeper technical discovery of your client’s processes, you realize you need a lot of custom changes to serve them.

That's the hidden tax on every enterprise sale, 3 months of bespoke FDE / Solution Architect’s work, rebuilt from scratch for every customer. That’s 3 months of lost value for the customer.

Either you wait months to start billing, or somehow show enough ROI in the remaining duration of the contract to get a renewal.

# **What we built**

[Lab0](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/lab0) is the AI FDE for your (AI?) B2B SaaS. It joins discovery calls and tells you what to ask, generates handoffs, design documents and test plans. It even configures the product, writes custom integrations and tests all the workflows before signing off.

_Six months of services work, done in days._

# **Who we are**

[Onkar Borade](https://www.linkedin.com/in/onkar-borade/) , CS grad from IIT Bombay, saw the problem from inside Oracle, where the implementation team was bigger than the dev team.

[Lakshya Gupta](https://www.linkedin.com/in/lakshya-gupta-0030771ba/) , also CS from IIT Bombay, was an early engineer at Emergent Labs where he scaled the Agent platform from 0 to $100M in ARR with over 5M users.

[Sujay Srivastava](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sujaysriv/) , quantum computing grad from IIT Madras, was building an AI startup for BFSI, where every rollout felt like its own custom project.

We've sat on every side of an enterprise deployment, and [Lab0](https://www.linkedin.com/company/lab0-hq/) is the software we wished we'd had on every one of those projects.

# **Our ask**

**1. Are you a company selling to enterprises where implementation is eating your team's time?** We'll take one of your hardest customer deployments and run it end-to-end; you'll see the value firsthand.

**2. Intros to Professional Services leaders / Customer Success / Solutions Architects** at enterprise software companies with 20+ person implementation teams. If you've seen this pain from a previous job - even from across the aisle in a product or engineering role, a warm intro goes a long way.

Drop an email at [founders@lab0.ai](https://mail.google.com/mail/?view=cm&fs=1&to=founders@lab0.ai)\
or\
Book a call at [Lab0-Calendly_Link](https://calendly.com/d/ctzx-ndw-n8b/office-hours-with-lab0)

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
Max led process optimization at Porsche. David built data pipelines in finance. Leon built AI automations at consultancies. They all noticed critical knowledge is trapped inside people's heads and never reaches the people who need it.

The team then felt inspired to work on the problem after a tour to Stockholms fastest scaling startups organized by Max, where all three decided to quit their jobs and start a company.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
Every company already has the answers to most of the questions leadership is asking.

The problem: those answers are scattered across hundreds of people, and there's never been a practical way to ask every single employee.

So leaders make crucial decisions with partial information or spend months and millions on external consultants to retrieve what the org already knows.

**What we're building**

Ontora is an AI agent that has a real conversation with every employee in your company within hours.

It learns, follows up, and surfaces what people actually do and where they get stuck.

We deliver two things: a synthesized answer to the specific question leadership couldn't crack in their last business review (themed insights, process maps, automation roadmap with ROI), and a continuously refreshed operational context that humans and AI agents can both reason over.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
Answers in hours instead of months. We imagine truly intelligence native companies that unlock the last proprietary data source left in the enterprise: operational knowledge living in your employees heads.

Enabling cost reduction, post-merger integration, and AI transformation… within hours and at a fraction of the cost of traditional consulting.

Every company we talk to has the same story: they bought Claude licenses for their teams but merely use it to rewrite emails. The AI transformation stalled because nobody mapped what to actually automate.

That's the real bottleneck. Not code. Context.

A 800-person European media agency flew to San Francisco to meet us after realizing they'd need 4-5 months and a team of consultants just to understand their own operations. With Ontora, they can map their entire company in days.

launches.title: Rex: Turn enterprise order-to-cash into an autonomous operation
launches.tagline: AI Operations Partner for Enterprise Order to Cash
launches.body:
Rex is an AI service that runs order-to-cash and accounts receivable operations for enterprises. Founders [Merlin Kafka](https://www.linkedin.com/in/merlinkafka/) and [Lewis Blackwood](https://www.linkedin.com/in/lewisblackwood) spent 4 years at an a16z-backed startup helping finance teams at startups like Cognition, Legora and Bridge automate revenue collection. The problem is 100x bigger in the enterprise, so they built Rex: agents that do the work end-to-end. Live in production with Synthesia.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BKS7qaZS8Is>

**Revenue ≠ cash**

Enterprises invoice customers, then spend months chasing the money through email chains, PDFs and ancient web portals. A $1M invoice sits unpaid because one PO number didn't match.

Multiply that across thousands of customers and you get 100+ person teams, often offshore, doing this by hand: collections, invoice submission, dispute resolution, deduction management, cash application. Order-to-cash is the most outsourced process in finance because the work needs judgment. Reading a customer's email and deciding whether their dispute is valid. Working out which of 14 open invoices a lump-sum payment covers. Knowing that this account always pays late but always pays, and that one needs escalating now.

AR automation software has existed for 20 years and the teams never got smaller, because the tools organise the work while people still do it. Businesses invoice each other tens of trillions of dollars a year; the labour and outsourcing spend on collecting it is over $100B. Until now the only way to scale was headcount or a BPO contract.

**What Rex does**

Rex connects to the ERP (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle), CRM (Salesforce), billing system and shared AR inbox, and learns how the team runs the process today. That knowledge becomes editable agent operating procedures: how to chase a Fortune 500 buyer vs a startup, which deductions get investigated vs written off, when a dispute goes to a human.

Then agents run those procedures across thousands of accounts in parallel:

* Collections and payment follow-ups, including the long tail no team gets to
* Invoice submission and status tracking inside procurement portals (SAP Ariba, Coupa, Tungsten and hundreds of others)
* Dispute and deduction investigation
* Remittance processing and cash application
* Responding to customer finance emails
* Updating ERP, CRM and billing records
* Routing exceptions to the team for approval

Portals deserve a special mention: an increasing share of enterprise invoices must be submitted and tracked inside the buyer's procurement system. It's the work AR teams hate most and the work software vendors ignore. Rex treats it as core.

**Is Rex a managed service or software?**

Enterprises can partner with Rex as a managed service provider or let their team operate Rex. AR software (dunning tools, collections worklists, AR dashboards) organises work for a team to do. Rex agents do the work, and the finance team approves exceptions. With Rex, the team stops drowning in routine chasing and handles the judgment calls. Customers compare Rex to their next AR hire, their offshore team, or their BPO contract.

**Can finance teams trust AI agents with collections?**

Autonomy is earned, not switched on. Each procedure starts supervised: Rex proposes, the team approves. Once a procedure hits its accuracy bar for the account, it graduates and runs autonomously. Safe, high-volume work goes first; judgment-heavy edges stay gated as long as the team wants. Every action is logged with its full reasoning, so finance audits the system instead of babysitting it.

**Traction**

[Rex is live in production with enterprises like Synthesia](https://www.rex.inc/customers/synthesia), running collections, portal submissions, inbox triage and cash application. Cases that used to take weeks of back and forth resolve in minutes.

**Get in touch**

If invoice volume is outgrowing the finance team, or order-to-cash runs on offshore headcount or a BPO contract, get in touch: [rex.inc](http://rex.inc)

launches.tagline: Record how you work and turn that into agents
launches.body:
screenpipe records what you do, see and hear on your computer, makes it searchable, and gives agents the context to understand how you actually work. The project has 20K+ GitHub stars.

<https://youtu.be/c1jV6E9pyug>

Most AI agents start every task with partial context.

They can read the prompt and apps you connect. They do not remember the meeting where a decision was made, the tab you opened last Tuesday, the exact steps you took to fix a problem, or the edge case you discovered while doing the work.

screenpipe runs quietly in the background and captures screen and audio context on your machine. Then you can ask:

* maintain a second brain for every person, projects, tasks, meetings


* turn the workday into a daily recap and time breakdown for standups or client billing
* maintain a personal CRM from the people, conversations, and follow-ups seen during the day
* find commitments mentioned in meetings or messages that never made it into a task list
* analyze repeated work and produce a list of workflows worth automating
* save prompts and context from Claude, Codex, and ChatGPT into a searchable journal

Agents can use screenpipe as long-term memory, so they work from what actually happened instead of only what you remembered to paste into a prompt.

The same foundation also works across team machines. Teams can map repeated workflows, generate SOPs, find bottlenecks, and identify automation opportunities across the tools where work actually happens.

screenpipe is open source and local-first. You control what gets recorded, can exclude apps, windows, and URLs, and choose where your data lives.

I’ve been building my own AI second brain since 2020, but it could only remember what I explicitly saved. I built screenpipe so my AI could understand what I was actually doing across my screen and conversations. Other people began using it for the same reason. Today, we’re turning that foundation into context for personal and team agents.

**Our ask**

Try screenpipe and comment with the agent you would build if it could remember everything you’ve worked on.

Try screenpipe: <https://screenpipe.com>

launches.tagline: Company-wide security monitoring for AI apps
launches.body:
# \*\*\*\*

**TL;DR:** AI agents are quietly pulling secrets off your employees' laptops — and your security gateway can't see it. Traceforce installs in under 5 minutes and gives you a full inventory of every AI app, MCP, and skill running on every device, then lets you block the dangerous stuff in real time. Built by the ex-Clumio engineering team. Traceforce is already deployed on 3,000+ devices across six enterprise customers, with 40+ active pilots worth $3M+ in ARR. Try it free at [www.traceforce.ai](http://www.traceforce.ai).\
\
**The incident that started this**\
At our last company, an AI coding agent running on a developer's laptop scraped what looked like database credentials and pushed them straight into a public GitHub repo. It took us _weeks_ to investigate, rotate credentials, and clean up the fallout. We got lucky — they were dev-environment creds, so no customer was affected. Next time, nobody will be that lucky.\
\
That's the whole problem with AI at work now: ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and Claude Code are everywhere on employee devices, wired into your data through MCPs and skills that no one is tracking. The tools your security team already owns — gateways, proxies, enterprise APIs — never see any of it, because the risky action happens _on the device_, before it ever hits the network.\
\
**Why us**\
We're Xia and Varun. We ran engineering at Clumio, a cyber-resilience company acquired by Commvault in 2024, where Xia was Director of Engineering and Varun was tech lead. We've spent our careers building security infrastructure — and we validated this problem with 50+ CISOs and CIOs before writing a line of code. Every one of them said the same thing: \_I need to see and control this without slowing my engineers down.\_\
\
**Why on-device — and why gateways can't do this**\
Competitors sit at the gateway or plug into enterprise APIs. That misses the self-adopted AI tools employees install themselves, and it can't see how an agent is actually connected to your data via MCPs. Traceforce runs on the endpoint, so we see the full picture — which AI apps are running, what MCPs and skills they're wired to, what data they can reach — and we can _warn or block_ an unsafe action the moment it happens, not after it's already on the network.\
\
**What you get**

* Install in <5 min. Full inventory of every AI app, MCP, and skill across your devices within 30 minutes.
* Discover shadow AI and see exactly how each agent connects to your data sources.
* Real-time controls: warn and block unsafe actions (like uploading a client list to a chatbot) before they happen.
* Open-source MCP pentesting: we also built [mcp-xray](https://github.com/traceforce/mcp-xray) to dynamically detect vulnerable MCPs — try it today.

\
**Traction**

* Securing 3000+ employee devices across 6 medium-sized enterprises.

launches.title: Rational - First Zero-human Accounting Firm
launches.tagline: Agents will be trusted.
launches.body:
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IX4-sMxdslk>

**We’re disrupting the disruptors.**

You’ve heard of so many AI accounting startups already. These new “AI-native” accounting firms are still designed to be run by humans in two facets: the first 25%, fostering client relationships, and the final 25%, signing off and filing with the IRS.

**Josh Kushner’s company, Thrive Holdings, the largest disruptor in this space, explicitly argues that agents will never replace this** \[1\]**.** Their reasoning? Agents don’t carry trust.

Currently, agents are not trusted, humans are. That’s why every AI startup nowadays does the work, and leaves judgment to a human. But this is changing, and we’re early. As new agent-centric companies grow (Instinct, Natural, AgentMail), agents become common in daily life and work, and eventually will become trusted entities \[2\].

Once agents are trusted, there is no reason they cannot own entire, traditionally trust-heavy industries, end-to-end. Rational is building for that world.

**Reach out to [founders@rational.to](mailto:founders@rational.to) or visit [rational.to](http://rational.to) if interested in learning more.**

---

\[1\] <https://www.thriveholdings.com/long-humans>. A fraction of the market does care about trust and the human relationship with their accountant, but most of us definitely do not want to spend a second more with one than we have to.

\[2\] These companies inherently bet on agents to proliferate in society. We also believe AI will continue to get better and safer. Since trust is achieved through consistent, positive actions, and it is in the interest of the entire tech industry for their agents to produce consistent positive actions, our firm will be the first to enjoy the principles to do concrete work in a massive market.

launches.body:
Rational builds AI employees for accounting and tax firms. They onboard themselves to your firm, handle real work within your existing tools, and keep a human in control of every decision that matters — so firms can finally say yes to the clients they've been turning away.

<https://youtu.be/mcF30tmNLTg>

_The problem_

Accounting has an economics problem: demand is there, capacity isn't. Most firms turned away paying clients last year simply because they didn't have the people to do the work, and the talent pool keeps shrinking as accountants leave the profession faster than firms can replace them. More software hasn't fixed this — and a chatbot that summarizes a spreadsheet definitely hasn't. The parts of accounting that actually matter, like judgment, trust, and sign-off, should stay human. Everything around them shouldn't have to be a bottleneck.

_Our solution_

Rational’s AI employees conduct interviews with each role on your team, creating a mental map of your firm’s workflows, inefficiencies, and who to route approvals to. After you connect them to your current stack, they simply do the work, 24/7. They learn from every single interaction and become more accurate over time — and their insights are completely isolated for your firm. They’re truly _your_ AI employees.

Rational already works with every firm size: from individuals to Fortune Global 500 companies. Doing everything from document-chasing to research to tax preparation, our employees supplement your firm’s labor without the significant onboarding curve or cost of a new hire.

_Book a Demo_

Stop saying no to clients or retaining inefficiencies in your firm. Hire your first AI employees today, at <https://rational.to/book-demo>.

name: Elimentary
long_description:
Elimentary’s is building AI agents that can run middle/back-office operations for private capital managers, starting with structured credit. Most private capital managers focus primarily on sourcing and capital deployment. Meanwhile post-investment operations receive step-child treatment. While AUMs have increased exponentially over the last decade, operations continue to be painfully supported by humans using spreadsheets and emails. Things have started to break leading to investment write-offs, fines, penalties, and sometimes lost LP relationships. 

Our agents can run these operations (borrowing base calcs, cracking loan tapes, NAV calculations, etc.) end to end autonomously. For one of our customers, our agents cut a 20-hour ops process to 30 minutes. It saved 90% of the manual hours, translating to $150k in annual savings.
one_liner: Agents that run middle/back-office operations for Private Capital
